intent: 在视觉预览上提供对象发现、定位和直接操作入口，同时明确该覆盖层只是交互/发现层，不冒充最终渲染器或字形命中权威。
use_when: 主预览需要直接选取/定位编辑对象
存在近似几何或语义锚点但最终视觉由独立 renderer 决定
固定布局与浮动/Canvas presentation 需要共享同一交互能力
do_not_use_when: 发现算法会被误解为精确 renderer glyph/bbox hit testing
覆盖层自身需要持有第二份领域对象状态

interaction_contract.registry: multiple presentation hosts consume one InteractionOverlayRegistry
interaction_contract.confidence: candidate confidence distinguishes explicit anchor, derived anchor and unresolved semantics
interaction_contract.actions: changing Focus and opening a pinned edit target are separate actions
interaction_contract.authority: preview discovery never overrides renderer authority
interaction_contract.lifecycle: overlay/proxy state is transient interaction state, not canonical document state

visual_contract.confidence: approximate discovery is labeled as approximate
visual_contract.overlay: must not obscure the primary preview beyond the active interaction
visual_contract.host_consistency: fixed and Canvas hosts present the same semantic interaction

constraints: Anchor discovery must not be described as glyph/bbox hit testing without renderer-backed evidence.
Interaction state must not be persisted as canonical domain data.
Presentation host changes must not duplicate interaction business logic.
